_readme: Example HTTP-shaped golden-master fixture manifest for the web-app extension (see docs/webapp-modernization.md). Same manifest shape overseer-gate.py's `golden-master` subcommand already reads (fixtures[].ruleIds + fixtures[].source == 'legacy-run'); each fixture additionally carries a 'request'/'response' pair, which is what makes it HTTP-shaped and puts it under `overseer-gate.py http-fixtures`'s extra check (request.method, request.path, response.status all present; no email/SSN-shaped string anywhere in the fixture -- a scripted synthetic walk must never capture real user data). A session-carrying flow needs a fixture SEQUENCE, not a single request -- GM-2 and GM-3 below share a cookie jar the walk script replays in order, exercising the constitution's Session / state rows, not just a route in isolation.
